description: Townsville City Council Water Wastewater and Waste Service Metrics is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Townsville City Council. Council’s performance against set targets for the delivery of water, wastewater and waste services. Reported quarterly and by financial year, and monthly for current financial year. Coverage: Townsville City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Townsville City Council. Its tags are drinking water quality, waste, wastewater, water. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
